title: BBQ Souvlaki Chicken Thighs
desc: Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken thighs off the barbecue, with sweet potato mash, broccoli and a high-protein tzatziki.

portions.J: 250 g chicken, about 300 g sweet potato mash, half the broccoli and tzatziki
portions.P: 150 g chicken, about 200 g sweet potato mash, half the broccoli and tzatziki

ingredients.name: Lebanese cucumber, grated and squeezed dry

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Mix the oil, lemon juice and zest, two of the garlic cloves, oregano, paprika and salt. Toss the chicken through and leave at least 20 minutes, or up to a day in the fridge.

steps.title: Boil the sweet potato
steps.text: Cover the sweet potato with cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer until a knife slides straight through.

steps.title: Make the tzatziki
steps.text: Stir the cucumber and the last garlic clove through the yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Keep it in the fridge.

steps.title: Barbecue the chicken
steps.text: Cook on a hot barbecue plate or grill, 5 to 6 minutes a side, until charred and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part).

steps.title: Rest, and cook the broccoli
steps.text: Rest the chicken 5 minutes. Steam or microwave the broccoli until bright green and just tender.

steps.title: Mash and serve
steps.text: Drain the sweet potato and mash with the butter and milk, then season. Slice the chicken and serve with the mash, broccoli and tzatziki.

notes: Leftover cooked thighs keep 3 days in the fridge for a lunch wrap.
